title: Conspiracy: Take the Crown: card flavor text

entities.name: Queen Marchesa
entities.description: Ruler of Paliano, a scheming queen who uses bribery, intimidation and poison to hold power.

entities.name: Adriana, Captain of the Guard
entities.description: Captain of the Guard who has pledged her sword to the defense of Paliano rather than the throne or the usurper.

entities.name: Leovold, Emissary of Trest
entities.description: Emissary of Trest who has plenty of time and money.

entities.name: Selvala
entities.description: A figure who speaks less and is answered more by nature.

entities.name: Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
entities.description: A goblin who proposes pillaging while others burn.

entities.name: General Takeno
entities.description: General who commands archers at Eiganjo.

entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: An angel who tells a lesser angel that outcasts are right.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Speaker who admires a masterless kami.

entities.name: Siara, the Dragon's Mouth
entities.description: Speaker who turns away someone from the Ojutai.

entities.name: Leukin
entities.description: Patrol leader who fled smoldering angel feathers.

entities.name: Bishop Cawle of Elgaud
entities.description: A bishop who speaks of a killer judge.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Speaker who stands up to Gix.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker troubled by unwelcome thoughts.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: Khan of the Mardu who made a legend from what Sarkhan abandoned.

entities.name: Kleon the Iron-Booted
entities.description: A hero who questions the gods.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A speaker nourished by Rath's growth.

entities.name: Urak
entities.description: A character killed by a manaplasm.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: A god who once loved Nylea.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: A god whose guidance turns venom into panacea.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: A goddess whose shrine was defended against the Returned.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: Sky goddess known to merfolk, called Kamsa by the kor.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan alleged by one merfolk to hide behind Emeria.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: A city ruled by Queen Marchesa.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A world of death and decay.

entities.name: Tal Terig
entities.description: Site of ruins scholars puzzled over.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: A plane with a vanished landmark.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane with hedrons and Eldrazi.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: A plane that grows, nourishing Volrath.

entities.name: The Returned
entities.description: Horde that attacked the shrine of Karametra.

entities.name: The Champion
entities.description: A hero who defended the shrine of Karametra, per The Theriad.

entities.name: The Theriad
entities.description: An in-world text recounting the Champion's stand.

events.summary: Adriana pledges her sword to the city's defense, not the throne or the usurper.
events.quote: My sword is pledged to the defense of this city, not to the throne or this usurper.

events.summary: Queen Marchesa's loyalists hail her as the true queen.
events.quote: Hail to the true queen! Long may she reign!

events.summary: Leovold offers to come to an arrangement.
events.quote: I'm sure we can come to an arrangement.

events.summary: Marchesa claims she offered her victims a choice.
events.quote: I did offer them a choice

events.summary: Zurgo tells Sarkhan he made a legend from what Sarkhan abandoned.
events.quote: I made a legend from what you abandoned.

events.summary: The Champion stood alone against the Returned at Karametra's shrine until the temple guardians awoke.
events.quote: The Champion stood alone between the horde of the Returned and the shrine to Karametra

events.summary: Xantcha defies Gix, telling him fear will never control her.
Leukin fled smoldering angel feathers, warning his patrol.
events.quote: Leukin stared at the smoldering angel feathers.

events.summary: The hedrons awoke along with the Eldrazi.
events.quote: The hedrons awoke along with the Eldrazi

events.summary: A landmark of Tazeem walked away.
events.quote: The last reliable landmark in Tazeem just walked away.

relations.note: Adriana warns that Marchesa's poison is delivered by more than daggers and calls her a usurper.
relations.quote: Marchesa's poison is delivered by more than daggers.

relations.note: Gisa calls Geralf her dear brother.
relations.quote: Here are some bones for you to choke on, dear brother!
